theorems.name: Submission.dor_lmbsf_pc_gram_det_succ_eq
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (a : Fin (n + 1) → Euclid P) (u : Euclid P), u ∈ Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range a) → inner ℝ u (a 0) = 1 → (∀ k : Fin n, inner ℝ u (a k.succ) = 0) → Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun i j : Fin n => inner ℝ (a i.succ) (a j.succ)) = ‖u‖ ^ 2 * Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun i j : Fin (n + 1) => inner ℝ (a i) (a j))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
